name: Strokill Prime
description: Strokill Prime was a waterworld in the Outer Rim Territories where the Galactic Empire operated an underwater base. The Mon Calamari king Lee-Char was kept prisoner in the base on Strokill Prime, but was killed by stormtroopers during a Rebel Alliance rescue attempt.
